title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative ideal-gas state and case nondimensional inputs at main.cpp:86–117 and report.tex:22–23; accuracy remains empirical.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS zones, TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 geometry and graph at main.cpp:168–245; CGNS MIXED sections are skipped.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-oriented residual and global norms implemented; major Re20 rank mismatch limits verified behavior.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Selectable Roe and Rusanov; report records case-specific selection and Re200 low-Mach adjustments.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield and wall implementations exist; no-slip wall rows are emitted as wall state; low-Mach accuracy remains limited.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares linear reconstruction and common Barth limiter in main.cpp:501–508,640–658; no smooth-order proof.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type common limiter and positivity backtracking are present; component mode is explicitly disabled in Re200 metadata.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier flux and explicit tangential traction projection main.cpp:1064,1271–1304; Cf uses absolute shear.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Local pseudo-time/Anderson source exists but accepted no-change states may satisfy plateau, with minimal residual reduction in low-Mach and Re20 cases.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Active-state BDF2 target checks and 30000 rows exist, but actual lift amplitude steadily decays despite periodic label.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS/neighbor communication and rank-local state are present; Re20 np1/8 order-one startup force difference reproduced independently.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
